description:
Job Family : 
Data Engineering & Architecture Consulting 
 Travel Required : 
Up to 50% 
 Clearance Required : 
Active Secret 
 
 What You Will Do : 
 Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines in Databricks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable engineering patterns.
 Transform raw source data into curated, analysis-ready datasets and dimensional models that support cybersecurity metrics, risk analysis, dashboards, and executive reporting.
 Develop automated data-quality controls for ETL jobs, including schema, completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness, referential-integrity, and source-to-target reconciliation checks.
 Define appropriate handling for failed quality checks, including quarantining invalid records, stopping critical loads, generating alerts, documenting exceptions, and coordinating corrective action with data owners.
 Schedule and orchestrate production workflows; monitor job status, freshness, throughput, latency, resource utilization, and failures; troubleshoot root causes; and restore processing within agreed service levels.
 Optimize pipeline reliability, performance, and cost through efficient transformations, workload configuration, incremental processing, partitioning, and compute-resource management.
 Implement and maintain data-governance and quality-assurance standards, including access controls, metadata, data classification, ownership, lineage, retention, auditability, and protection of sensitive cybersecurity information.
 Maintain source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, transformation rules, validation evidence, standard operating procedures, runbooks, and other technical documentation needed for operations, knowledge transfer, and audit readiness.
 Partner with cybersecurity analysts, data owners, system administrators, dashboard developers, and business stakeholders to define data requirements, metrics, thresholds, and acceptance criteria.
 Maintain effective working relationships with client management and staff, anticipate stakeholder needs, communicate delivery risks and dependencies, and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner.
 Organize and lead client meetings by coordinating schedules, developing and distributing agendas and pre-read materials, facilitating discussions and decisions, recording minutes, maintaining required documentation, and tracking action items through closure.
 Participate in peer reviews, testing, release activities, and continuous-improvement efforts to strengthen engineering practices, reduce recurring defects, and improve the reliability and usability of data products.
 
 What You Will Need : 
 An ACTIVE and CURRENT SECRET federal security clearance
 Bachelor’s degree
 SIX (6) years of total experience in a data or programming discipline, including THREE (3) years of experience in data engineering
 Proficiency in data engineering-related programming languages such as Python, PySpark, and/or SQL
 Experience with scheduling, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing production ETL/ELT pipelines
 Experience with data engineering principles and best practices
 Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
 Selected Candidate must be able to commute to client and Guidehouse offices as needed
   
 What Would Be Nice To Have : 
 Master’s degree in computer science or related field
 Experience working with system and application logs
 Familiarity with the Databricks platform
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment
 
 
The annual salary range for this position is $85,000.00-$141,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. 
 What We Offer : 
 Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.
 
 Benefits include:
 Medical, Rx, Dental & Vision Insurance

 Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays

 Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus

 Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance

 401(k) Retirement Plan

 Basic Life & Supplemental Life

 Health Savings Account, Dental/Vision & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

 Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

 Student Loan PayDown

 Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development & Learning Opportunities

 Skills Development & Certifications

 Employee Referral Program

 Corporate Sponsored Events & Community Outreach

 Emergency Back-Up Childcare Program

 Mobility Stipend

 
 About Guidehouse
